snippet.title: Official Forgotten Memories Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Forgotten Memories by Psychoz Interactive

First Teaser of our upcoming iOS survival horror "Forgotten Memories".
Entirely recorded at runtime, using heavy post process and shaders.

Homepage:

http://www.forgottenmemoriesthegame.com/
